Name: Nethaneel, Son of Zuar
Summary: Nethaneel, son of Zuar, was the prince of the tribe of Issachar at the census in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Nethaneel led Issachar's 54,400 men and brought the tribe's offering for the dedication of the altar.
LifeLesson: Faithful men lead best when they simply show up where God counts them.
